opening_situation: At dawn, Hero stands at the old bridge, where a locked iron gate blocks the way; a guard says the brass key is in the mill.

scenes.title: Locked iron gate at dawn
scenes.node_description: An old bridge whose way is blocked by a locked iron gate, watched by a guard.
scenes.obstacle: A locked iron gate blocks the bridge.
scenes.approach: Hero listens to the guard and resolves to find the brass key.
scenes.outcome: Hero cannot pass and decides to seek the brass key to open the gate.

scene_moments.text: The Guard said the brass key is in the mill, and Hero intends to find it to cross the bridge.

scenes.title: Empty iron hook beside the doorway
scenes.node_description: The mill where the Guard said the brass key would be found.
scenes.obstacle: The brass key is missing from the mill.
scenes.approach: Hero stops at the mill doorway to investigate.
scenes.outcome: Hero has not found the key and is beginning to investigate at the doorway.

scene_moments.text: An empty iron hook hangs beside the mill doorway, and the key is not there despite the Guard's claim.

endcap.end_situation: Hero is alone at the mill doorway, investigating beside the empty iron hook where the brass key is missing.

session_matters.text: Hero wants to cross the old bridge, which is blocked by a locked iron gate that needs the brass key.
Where is the brass key? The bridge Guard said it is in the mill, but the iron hook beside the mill doorway is empty and the key is missing.
